integrity: Unrestricted assertion proved by ternary-position and period-inflation lemmas; independent finite enumeration to level six confirms exact interval/period triples but does not certify the infinite case.
limitations: Complete finite Cantor substitution iterates only; no claim for arbitrary prefixes, altered morphisms, or Abelian periods. Historical priority cannot be established exhaustively from searchable archives.
title: Complete maximal-repetition spectra of finite binary Cantor words
